narrative.overview: ResQAI is read like an operations console, not a marketing site. The screen is a dark instrument panel: near-black ground, one signal-teal channel carrying live status, and mono-spaced labels that read like telemetry. Every surface is built for a responder glancing at a phone in bad weather or an operator watching a wall display for six hours. Calm urgency beats spectacle — the interface stays quiet until something is actually wrong.
keyCharacteristics: Dark, telemetry-first surfaces with a single teal signal channel
Mono for labels, numbers, and headings; Inter for prose
Severity color is semantic: red = critical, amber = caution/sample, green = safe/live
Tonal layering and glass instead of drop shadows
Compact 4/8px rhythm tuned for dashboards, not landing pages
Honest data states: live, cached, and sample are visually distinct

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Teal occupies ≤10% of any screen. If two elements compete for it, one is wrong.

rules.name: The Severity Means Something Rule
rules.body: Red, amber, and green are reserved for operational state. Decorative use of a severity hue is a bug, not a style choice.

rules.name: The Sample Is Amber Rule
rules.body: Any synthetic, seeded, or illustrative data wears DemoDataBadge in Caution Amber. No sample data ships unlabeled.

rules.name: The Numbers Are Mono Rule
rules.body: Any value a user compares — counts, percentages, coordinates, timestamps — uses the display face and tabular-nums where available.

rules.name: The Uppercase Is Small Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracking is for ≤12px labels only. Never set a sentence in uppercase.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Panels are flat at rest. A shadow appears only as a response to state (hover, focus, alert) or to lift a map popup above tiles.

dos: Do keep Signal Teal to one primary action and the live channel per view.
Do use mono for every number, timestamp, coordinate, and status label.
Do label every sample, seeded, or cached dataset with DemoDataBadge and say what is live.
Do use 1px Hairline borders and tonal steps for separation before reaching for a shadow.
Do keep body text at 14px Inter with ≥4.5:1 contrast against Panel.
Do keep touch targets ≥44×44px and preserve map height on small screens.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: status pulses and scan lines stop, final states remain.
donts: Don't introduce a light theme or a second accent hue; the system is dark-only and single-signal.
Don't use severity colors (red/amber/green) for decoration, gradients, or visual interest.
Don't use emoji as structural icons; use Lucide at a consistent 16px.
Don't set sentences in uppercase or use mono for long-form prose.
Don't stack glass surfaces or add drop shadows to resting cards.
Don't show a metric derived from Math.random() or seed data without a visible badge.
Don't let a fixed header, legend, or chat panel cover keyboard focus or content on mobile.
